column1: # Sarah, the optional super boss in Kalay (Kalay_TalkToSarah).

column3:
Kalay is loud today.
Nobody here looks up.
Nobody sees me.{page_break}You do, though.
You stopped. You
looked right at me.{end_wait}
Who are you?\nYou aren't from Kalay.{end_wait}

Sarah. That's all
that's left of me.
I was never finished.{page_break}Nobody wrote an ending
for me. So I'll take
one from you instead.{end_wait}

So that's how it feels
to lose. I wasn't
made to find out.{page_break}Keep walking, Isaac.
Someone will write
your ending for you.{end_wait}
You're not ready.\nCome back with the\nfull company.{end_wait}
